title: alibaba/open-code-review
lede: Open Code Review is Alibaba's AI code review CLI, pairing fixed engineering steps for file selection and comment placement with an LLM agent that writes line-level review comments.

points: Reads Git diffs and lets the agent open whole files and search the codebase for context; ocr scan reviews code with no diff.
Bundles related files into sub-agents with isolated context so large changesets are covered in full.
Matches built-in rules for null pointers, thread safety, XSS and SQL injection to each file.
Alibaba reports higher precision than Claude Code on the same model at about a ninth of the tokens, accepting lower recall.
Works with OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints, or delegates the review to the host coding agent's own model.
